text:
jen_partnerships: quick sync  CipherLink (SI) reached out about a co-listed MSSP package pairing Redwood Private + CipherLink secrets. asks: SAML SSO sample, SCIM group/user provisioning, and a KMS key-wrap demo (they prefer KMIP). They want a short integration runbook + smoke script by EOW for their partner webinar. @samir_eng @lee_security can we commit?

samir_eng: I can own the smoke. need to confirm whether CipherLink expects symmetric key-wrap only or also HSM-backed asymmetric operations. also: do they require KMS calls from inside the Private VPC or will they proxy via their service?

jen_partnerships: CipherLink says BYOK via KMIP endpoint (they mentioned KeyLattice as the vendor). they specifically called out wrap/unwrap for secret rotation, not signing. timeline: webinar next Thursday, so tight.

lee_security: BYOK via KMIP is fine as long as we document certificate pinning and CA thumbprint checks. we should include a short threat-model snippet (cross-tenant KMS creds, replay attacks on provisioning). no real certs in docs.

alex_ops: ops can provide a KMIP emulator AMI for staging (kmip-emu:v2). I'll hand off AMI id and a cloud-init snippet for mounting the emulator into the test VPC.

olivia_sales: CipherLink will stand up a dev tenant and provide a non-prod KMIP endpoint and test certs. they'll also want an integration checklist so they can provision service accounts/roles ahead of time.

samir_eng: plan: 1) exchange SAML metadata + show a signed assertion sample, 2) SCIM token + incremental group sync example, 3) KMIP key-wrap handshake against emulator, 4) rotate call against Redwood Private to verify unwrap/wrap. I'll produce a tiny bash smoke script.

samir_eng: SCIM token example:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://dev.cipherlink.example/scim/token \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"client_id":"cipher-dev","client_secret":"REDACTED"}'
```

samir_eng: rotate sample (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://private-api.staging.redwood-inference.local/v1/secrets/rotate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>' \
  -d '{"secret_id":"cipher-demo-secret","kms_key_id":"kmip://cipher-key-01"}'
```

deploy-bot: CI pipeline #cipherlink-integ smoke-tests finished  9 tests, 1 flaky (SCIM large-group pagination). logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/alg/7777 :white_check_mark:

samir_eng: flaky due to large SCIM page sizes. switching to incremental sync with exponential backoff and adding an idempotency header to provisioning calls. will push updated script by Tue EOD.

lee_security: include idempotency token guidance, CA thumbprint validation, and a simple rollback play: if rotation fails, restore previous wrapping key and mark affected secrets read-only. add note: rotate tokens frequently and avoid long TTL service tokens.

maria_pm: I can draft the 1-pager + 3-slide webinar intro if eng supplies commands, a short sequence diagram, and 2 sanitized screenshots by Wed.

jen_partnerships: action items: Samir (E2E smoke + script)  Tue EOD; Alex (KMIP AMI + cloud-init)  Tue AM; Olivia (partner dev tenant & test certs)  Wed AM; Lee (security blurb + threat-model snippet & rollback)  Wed EOD; Maria (runbook + slides)  Wed EOD. partner marketing needs final assets Thu for rehearsals.

olivia_sales: I'm nudging CipherLink now for the test certs and service-account details.

samir_eng: temporary internal repo with scripts: https://git.internal/redwood/cipherlink-integ. will sanitize for external share.

lee_security: small doc ask: include CA thumbprint verification steps for the KMIP TLS handshake and a short checklist to validate the partner's KMIP principal doesn't have cross-tenant access to other keys.

jen_partnerships: perfect. we'll collect the pieces and ship a draft runbook tomorrow for review. thanks everyone :rocket:
